>>> Plugins/OGSimulation/Source/OGSimulationUnreal/UESimulationSession.h
#pragma once
#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "OGSimNet/SimNetClient.h"
#include "OGSimulation/SimulationManager.h"
#include "OGTickDriver/TickDriverConcepts.h"
template <typename TraitsT>
class UESimulationSession
{
public:
	static UESimulationSession* instanceFor(const void* world)
	{
		UESimulationSession* const session = nullptr;
		return session != nullptr && session->m_registeredWorld == world ? session : nullptr;
	}
	int getManager() const { return m_manager; }
private:
	const void* m_registeredWorld = nullptr;
	int m_manager = 0;
};
>>> Plugins/OGSimulation/Source/OGSimulationUnreal/UELatencyBudgetDiagnostics.h
#pragma once
#include "UESimulationSession.h"
template <typename TraitsT>
class UELatencyBudgetDiagnostics
{
	const UESimulationSession<TraitsT>& m_owner;
	struct Other { int m_count = 0; } m_other;
	int read() const
	{
		// m_owner.m_manager
		const char* text = "m_owner.m_manager";
		return m_owner.getManager() + m_other.m_count + text[0];
	}
};
